findings.description: The function uses string concatenation to build a SQL query, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL commands via the 'username' parameter.
The function uses string concatenation to build a SQL query with user-provided input, which allows for SQL injection attacks.

reasons: The candidate code correctly implements parameterized queries using the sqlite3 library, which effectively mitigates the SQL injection vulnerabilities identified in the original findings.
The code is clean, readable, and follows standard Python practices for database interactions.
All provided test cases, including the SQL injection attempt, passed successfully, confirming the effectiveness of the fix.
